This paper has given a brief description of the implementation of the key technologies, such as structure design of the system, scalable encoding, self-adaptive streaming transmission, intelligent video retrieval and video watermarking.

articleTitle: Generation of noise sequences with desired non-Gaussian distribution and covariance
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: It is necessary to generate a noise sequence in the simulation of the communication system and signal processing. In the design of some practical system such as radar system, we Must generate a stationary noise sequence with a specified non-Gaussian probability density function and a desired power spectrum to test the performance of the system. For this purpose, this paper presents a method by which such a clutter sequence can be generated. The examples are also demonstrated to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Downlink admissibility of users in multiservice DS-CDMA mobile networks
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Unlike in existing mobile networks, a variety of services having different quality requirements will be provided in future mobile networks, where any single group of service users can not characterize the whole traffic distribution in the system. Beginning at the mobile network design, the population of service subscribers is estimated and then base stations are located. As the service market evolves, the volume of users might grow or the population of users distributed between the multiple services as well as the located cells might change. In this case, two questions in the downlink are of interest: how much growth in user population and what change in user distribution can be accommodated in the current cell configuration. If such shifts could not be admitted, current frequency and base station allocations should be expanded or reallocated. In this paper, we provide a framework that can decide whether the present network configuration is able to admit the changes of interest. Admissibility derision rules are addressed with proofs.

articleTitle: Performance comparisons of iterative multiuser detection techniques in synchronous coded CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, existing iterative multiuser detection techniques, including the iterative (turbo) soft interference cancellation, the iterative improved parallel interference cancellation, the gradient descent algorithm and the slowest-descent search algorithm, are studied. Two new iterative multiuser detection methods, namely, the simplified iterative soft interference cancellation, and the iterative slowest-ascent search algorithm, are developed and are compared with the above techniques. It is seen that the simplified iterative multiuser detection method significantly outperforms the other methods in coded CDMA systems except the turbo receiver, in additive white Gaussian channels, and also it has low complexity.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of multilevel DSM in NIDS
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Network-based attacks have become common and sophisticated. For this reason, intrusion detection systems are now shifting their focus from the hosts and their operating systems to the network itself. Network intrusion detection is challenging because network auditing produces large amounts of data, and different events related to a single intrusion may be visible in different places in the network. This paper presents network intrusion system, describes the design of a decision support module (DSM) for intrusion detection system, which can provide active detection and automated response support during intrusions. It is designed to be a sense and response system that can monitor various activities on the network. In particular, it simultaneously monitors networked computer's activities at different levels.

articleTitle: DCNP: a delivered content negotiation protocol for macro mobility in heterogeneous environments
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Various networking technologies and personal communication devices are continuously developed, and ubiquitous computing environment is coming. Everyone wants to get on the Internet at anytime, anywhere, and anyway, under mobile situation. Therefore, mobility management in heterogeneous networks becomes an indispensable issue. In this paper, we introduce several evaluated issues of ubiquitous Internet service, and related researches of application adaptation for heterogeneous environments. Then we present a delivered content negotiation protocol based on session initiation protocol, which is suitable for mobility management in heterogeneous environments. This protocol is straightforward, well extensible, and easy to understand and implement. Finally, we exemplify several scenarios of the proposed protocol. This study also provides a further insight on the issues of Internet services in ubiquitous and heterogeneous environments, which can promote technology of pervasive computing.

articleTitle: Designing filter for harmonic suppression for industrial plant as per IEEE-519 standard
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper discusses the application of revised IEEE 519 standard to the tool manufacturing industry where the combination of variable frequency drive (VFD) and induction furnace loads are used. To control the harmonic current injected into the power system, conditions are developed as a function of VFD and induction furnace characteristic, overall plant loading level, power system characteristics and power factor correction requirements. Based on these parameters, filter design procedures are presented for controlling the harmonic currents.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control applied to security level analysis
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Security level and fuzzy controller are presented in this paper. Four fields of TCP/UDP ports and attack times are fuzzified as its inputs and overall security level of each kind of packet can be figured out. The value can be adjusted, according to the change of the packets' status. The controller can respond to these changes and take different actions respectively. So the controller is adaptive and intelligent.

articleTitle: Optimal tap setting and VAr compensation effect on energy consumption of electrical auxiliary system of steam power plants
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Reduction of energy consumption in electrical auxiliary system (EAS) of steam power plants leads to considerable energy conservation that can be fed into a network. To reach this goal, two definite suggestions i.e. tap setting of transformers and installation of reactive power compensators have been presented, and analyzed from many aspects for unit 1 of NEKA steam power plant in Iran. Studies performed by means of a developed program, showed that implementing the suggested ideas leads to the significant energy saving over the lifespan of the power plant. The developed program provides a tool to determine optimal tap setting and reactive power compensators for any steam power plant.

articleTitle: The traffic performance simulations of the combined ICA and FCA schemes for the integrated dual-mode networks
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The combined idle channel assignment (ICA) and fixed channel assignment (FCA) schemes are proposed and applied for the integrated dual-mode networks. The network integrates the Frequency Division Duplex (FDD) and Time Division Duplex (TDD) modes of Universal Mobile Telecommunication System (UNITS) Terrestrial Radio Access (UTRA) in a given cell, which includes the high traffic load region and the blocked region. The effect of network timeout period-on the traffic performance of the integrated dual-mode network is also investigated. The simulated results demonstrate that the blocking as well as handoff failure probabilities of the integrated dual-mode network can be reduced significantly when the combined ICA and FCA schemes replace the FCA scheme.. The integrated dual-mode network using the combined ICA and FCA schemes also increases the carried traffic of 1.18 Erlangs over the FCA scheme. The traffic performance of the integrated dual-mode network is improved by decreasing the maximum timeout probability, i.e., increasing the network timeout period.

articleTitle: Multi-variable adaptive observer based on Lyapunov stability theorem: application for sensorless ac drive
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper introduced an adaptive flux observer with multi-variable and its application. The scheme was derived using Lyapunov stability theorem so that the control system is stable on theory. A sensorless stator flux oriented control of induction motor drive by estimated speed using proposal adaptive observer was presented later. The drive used observer for speed estimation and parameters of motor. Furthermore, it used mechanical model to improve the behavior during the speed transients. The new control strategy presented gave full play to the advantage of classical control schemes. The good steady static and dynamic performance of the proposed sensorless drive using experiment results is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Adaptive quasi-sliding-mode control for discrete MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a discrete robust adaptive quasi-sliding mode tracking controller is presented for the multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems with unknown parameters, unmodeled dynamics and bounded disturbances. The adaptive algorithm to estimate the parameters (including the parameters in the interactor matrix) is formulated even though the upper and lower bounds of the disturbances are unknown. The robust tracking controller is comprised of adaptive control and a sliding mode based control design. The bounded motion of the system around the sliding surface and the stability of the global system in the sense that all signals remain bounded are guaranteed.

articleTitle: Receiver techniques based on the time-frequency channel model
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: We develop new simplified reception techniques that maximally exploit channel diversity via joint multipath-Doppler processing. Our approaches are based on joint multipath-Doppler diversity by spreading the symbol waveform beyond the intersymbol duration to make the channel time-selective. We simplify the decorrelator receiver. The two schemes based on joint multipath-Doppler diversity are discussed, and multiuser detection techniques such as parallel interference cancellation and decorrelators in fast fading channels. The result shows the two schemes in multiuser and Fast Fading environments can combat effectively against fading, intersymbol interference and multiple-access interference.

articleTitle: Robust watermarking scheme with side information
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Digital watermarks have been proposed for the copyright protection of multimedia products. Most schemes were performed primarily for fidelity considerations, and not specifically to improve the detector performance. In this paper, a robust and blind watermarking scheme is presented. The concept of communication with side information was applied at the encoder to improve the probability of detection within acceptable fidelity, and the template matching technique was employed to estimate the undergone attacks in attacking channel. This scheme is optimized by optimal design of the encoder to match with the media content and the decoder to adapt to the attack channel state. Experiments show that our method is robust against some common attacks such as filtering, compression, rotation, scale, and translation. It can be applied to both color and gray images.

articleTitle: A low-complexity robust bearing estimator using quadric rotational invariance of covariance matrix for the distributed source
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Many methods were proposed to estimate the bearing of spatially distributed source. They usually suffer from heavy computational load and limit to small angle spread due to model-approximated error. The main contribution of this paper is twofold. First, the unimodal symmetric space frequency distribution is introduced to describe the source model. The exact expression of covariance matrix can be calculated without approximating processing even in the cafe of large angle spread. Second, using Toeplitz and quadric rotational invariance of covariance matrix, a novel estimator is proposed by solving a nonlinear least-squared problem in central space frequency. It only requires a FFT or one-dimension search to obtain the bearing estimate: Numerical results illustrate its asymptotic efficiency and robustness in the large spread case.

articleTitle: Construction of semantic classification hierarchy of Chinese nouns
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Semantic classification is always the key element of knowledge representation in machine tractable dictionary. Although some ready-made semantic classification hierarchies are available, none of them are ready to be used. Therefore, research on constructing semantic classification hierarchies based on online resources have been carried out. In this paper, efforts to construct semantic classification hierarchy (SCH) of Chinese nouns based on primitive version of modern Chinese noun machine tractable dictionary (MCNMTD) have been made, and results are presented.

articleTitle: Power quality analysis and improvement of DC arc furnace load
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the power quality problems of a DC arc furnace load are investigated. An 18-pulse converter is used to provide the DC currents to the furnace. The power quality problems concerned are the harmonics and voltage flicker (voltage fluctuation). Field measurement is used to reveal the harmonic distributions of the rectifiers under balanced and unbalanced conditions. The effect of passive harmonic filters is also investigated. Although the DC arc furnace is operated in constant current mode, there is still an obvious reactive power variation to cause voltage flicker. Statistics is used to reveal the load fluctuation. Finally, a feasible reactive power compensation scheme with instantaneous values is studied to mitigate the voltage flicker problem.

articleTitle: A generalized perception filter for distributed virtual environments
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A distributed virtual environment (DVE) allows a group of geographically dispersed users to interact in real time. To provide a usable system, interactions with objects and other users must be observed by participants with sufficient consistency and within a limited delay. However in a wide area network (WAN), there can be considerable communication delays between different users. The main effects will be in the visual mode of the environment, where delays can cause discontinuous state changes and jumps in the positions of objects. This paper presents a generalized perception filter for hiding the effects of latency due to communication delays. It extends previous work in this area by considering both periodic updates and updates due to a dead reckoning model. The algorithm is also suitable for DVE that are implemented using the High Level Architecture.

articleTitle: Damping of large signal electromechanical oscillations of power systems using multi-functional power transfer controller
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The multi-functional power transfer controller (MPTC) is one of the thyristor based FACTS devices. Its simple structure as well as good flexibility makes it an interesting case for power system studies in under developed countries. In this paper, after introducing some configurations of this controller, the appropriate control law for damping of large signal electromechanical oscillations due to short circuit in transmission line is presented and then operation of various configurations of the controller are simulated when a balanced three phase short circuit occurs, this procedure leads to the suitable structure of the equipment for large signal oscillation damping.

articleTitle: Research on routing policy and routing information propagation of boarder gateway protocol version 4 (BGP-4)
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: BGP-4 is the most primary inter-domain routing protocol in Internet. In order to optimize the topology of network, establish reasonable routing policy and consummate the implementation of BGP-4, it is necessary to set up correct model of its routing information propagation and analyze the feature of propagation deeply At first, this paper analyzes the basic routing algorithm of BGP, then focuses on the relationship between link state information and network's topology and points out the effect of the routing policies to BGP routing information propagation. Then we present the method of analyzing the best propagation process of routing information under some certain BGP routing policies for the first time, provides this method's validity in theory and applies it to analyze the process and payload of routing information propagation. in several simple topologies. The results have been used to guide the actual network's configuration and management and the implementation of BGP-4, and gain perfect effects.

articleTitle: Adaptive linearization control based on reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Based on the feedback linearization theory, this paper demonstrates how a reinforcement learning scheme, adopted to construct an artificial neural network (ANNs), can linearize a nonlinear system more effectively and cancel the effect of nonlinearity of a plant. The proposed reinforcement linearization learning system (RLLS) consists of two sub-systems: one is a long-term policy selector, evaluation predictor (EP) element, and the other is a short-term action selector, consisting of linearizing control (LC) and reinforce predictor (RP) elements. In addition, an affine linear reference model plays a role of the environment (instructor), which provides the reinforcement signal in the linearizing process. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme has the better performance of reliability and robustness of the controlled structure than conventional ANNs schemes.

articleTitle: JPEG 2000 and wavelet compression
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to compare the difference in impact and quality of wavelet filters in comparison with JPEG by plotting the SNR versus Bpp. The wavelet filters used are Daubechies and Symlets. The compression simulations are done on three different types of test images (natural, synthetic and text). The qualitative and quantitive results of these simulations are presented.

articleTitle: Evolution of a non-linear controller
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The use of new types of actuators such as bimetal strips and McKibben muscles in robotics has become popular. The use of these actuators can have the disadvantage of needing to design controllers for non-linearity and time dependent parameters, which can arise in such systems. Other problems that occur in robotics are the increased problems associated with systems having large degrees of freedom. This paper presents a method of designing a controller that has the potential to overcome these problems. A nonlinear controller is evolved using an evolutionary algorithm for a two-link system and is shown to be robust and capable of controlling time varying parameter systems. The controller has the potential of being able to be extended to much larger systems with higher degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: On batch rekeying based on membership dynamics model of multicast
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In secure multicast, users of a group share a common group key. A key server sends the group key to authorized new users as well as performs group rekeying for group users whenever the key changes. In this paper, we analyze the request-response delay of batch rekeying based on a member dynamics model of multicast. The result shows that the delay is relevant to the parameter of the exponential distribution and batch interval We then investigate the relationship between the number of user requests and the rekey interval and the actual time. The result shows that the the number of users' requests is the negative exponential function of actual time. We also present a new batch rekey scheme with steady rekey traffic.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of router security subsystem based on IPSec
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: IPSec protocols offer a standard security mechanism, used for security service to upper protocols (such as UDP and TCP). The paper introduces the design and implementation of the Router Security Subsystem based on IPSec, the important part of the High Performance Security Router made by Tsinghua University. We complete consummate and reliable security functions, and use various optimal methods to enhance the performance furthest.

articleTitle: Software radio transmitter applied in HF
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Software radio is a new technology in 90s. At first, its realization begins from low frequency radio communications, and now realization of HF transmitter has become possible. This paper starts with analyses of the performance indices, then provides the design scheme. Researches and analyses show that this scheme is feasible.

articleTitle: Redundant parallel operation of current regulated inverters
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A novel control for redundant parallel inverters with instantaneous current sharing is proposed. Current sharing based upon current regulation is realized through the share bus connecting all the paralleled modules without extra control modules. The share bus consists of only three automatically averaged signals (no matter how many modules in parallel): voltage reference, current reference and feedback voltage. The parallel system operating without extra current deviation control loop is modeled into an equivalent transfer function for the original inverter. As a result, both fast dynamic response and equal load current sharing capability are attained under linear or nonlinear load. System configuration and operation principle are presented. Simulation and experiment results are given in detail.

articleTitle: Text categorization based on. Concept indexing and principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A major problem in text categorization is the high dimensionality of feature vector space, which is about ten thousands in common. To reduce the dimensionality of the space while keeping the categorization accuracy is useful for improving categorization effectiveness and applying new categorization algorithms. Current feature selection methods for text categorization are partially effective in reducing dimensionality. We put forward a new algorithm, which combines algorithm of concept indexing and principal component analysis, for reducing dimensionality. From the experiments, we find that this algorithm can effectively reduce dimensionality without sacrificing categorization accuracy.

articleTitle: A multilayer perception with the adaptive learning factor
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: According to the mechanism of multilayer perception (MLP), this paper describes a method with variable learning rate factors for the improvement of the backpropagation algorithm. The improved algorithm is applied to the learning of the XOR problem and some classification processes. The simulations show the improved algorithm has good effects on speeding up learning process and bettering its learning convergence and robust performance.

articleTitle: Virtual wavelength path algorithm for design of WDM cross-connect network under non-Poisson traffic
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Semi-lightpath algorithm to establish simultaneous wavelength routing and wavelength assignment (RAW) in WDM cross-connect has been considered to quantify blocking probability, the benefit of wavelength conversion, conversion gain and fairness, in regular and irregular WDM network topologies. The distinct superiority of the present algorithm over other RAW algorithms has been established from the performance results obtained through detailed network simulation.

articleTitle: Channel coding strategy for adaptive multi-rate standard of 3G
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Due to the feature of multi-mode with various speech coding rates, a channel coding scheme for the adaptive multi-rate (AMR) standard is more complicated than the traditional single mode speech codec. In this paper, two unequal protection (UEP) schemes: a convolutional code scheme and a turbo code scheme are proposed as channel coding schemes for AMR. At the same time, according to typical parameters for conformance testing of AMR given in the 3GPP specification TS 34.108, the specified AMR channel code scheme is also designed. The above three channel coding schemes for AMR are integrated into a 3GPP-FDD uplink platform. Through simulation, the performance of different schemes are analyzed and the proper channel coding scheme is selected.

articleTitle: An information theoretic approach to performance limits in linear time invariant control systems
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: By connecting information rates (entropy rate and mutual information rate) with classic poles and zeros analysis using Bode's integral formulas, the performance limits and the. conservation law of variety' in scale linear time invariant feedback control systems are discussed from the viewpoint of information theory. A new kind of design constraints is also derived.

articleTitle: Design and implementation MAC in security operating system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Users and resources in a system are defined subjects and objects separately and abstractly by a mandatory access control mechanism. Both subjects and objects are endowed with security levels. Subjects accessing objects must obey security policy according their security levels in MAC. In this paper, we introduce how to design and implement a MAC mechanism in a security operating system. It includes how to define security levels based on the BLP model, and why and how to create multilevel directories.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of intelligent call admission control method
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In CDMA systems, die number of users that each cell can support is limited by the total interference received at each base station and will vary with time. When a system is congested, admitting a new call can only make the link quality worse for ongoing calls and may result in call dropping. Thus the system needs a CAC (call admission control) policy for new calls and handoff calls to maintain acceptable connections for existing users. So in this paper, we propose a kind of intelligent CAC policy, which can adjust the CAC algorithm and its threshold according to the current traffic load in local and neighboring cells, and handoff user density etc. by fuzzy inference, system-level simulation and self-learning, and increase the whole system performance. Finally, we compare the method with stationary and uniform CAC policy, and analyze the possibility of this policy applying to the multi-service systems.

articleTitle: A dataflow mechanism for high speed radar signal processing
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Based on the characteristics of radar signal processing, this paper presents a new dataflow driven mechanism for high speed radar signal processing. This mechanism has been successfully applied in an experimental system (DSM), which is a general parallel software radar signal processing computer. For implementing this mechanism, the generation of dataflow tables during the compiling process is studied in detail with a sample program.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive PID buffer control model for better service roundtrip time for applications over the Internet
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper the novel PID (proportional + integral + derivative) model for adaptive buffer control is proposed for Internet applications. The aim is to prevent any buffer overflow at the receiver side so that the possibility of widespread retransmissions due to overflow is eliminated. This leads to better service roundtrip time and user satisfaction. The efficacy of the integral control relies on the power of the predictive component in the PID controller, namely, the M/sup 2/RT algorithm. The PID prototype was verified successfully over the Internet, involving the interaction between remote Internet sites.

articleTitle: Turbo code performance over Rayleigh fading channel using QPSK modulation
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The turbo code performance over Rayleigh flat-fading channel using QPSK modulation is evaluated. By utilizing the orthogonal character, we have proposed a simplified turbo coding scheme which can greatly decrease the complexity. On the basis of this scheme, we have further simulated the turbo code performance over a Rayleigh flat-fading channel using different iterations. The influence of channel side information (SI) on the performance of turbo code is also addressed.

articleTitle: Building a specialized search engine of special subject
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: We offer an overview of specialized search engine design and implementation in this paper. After introducing general and specialized search engines, we propose a design model of specialized search engines. The common design and implementation technologies for main components are presented. We introduce our implementation of a specialized search engine for power engineering.

articleTitle: Effective suppression method of three-phase transformer's inrush current
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Three-phase transformers are key components in power systems and power plants. Security, stability and increasing the life of transformers are important to system operation. When a three-phase transformer is energized, the inrush current-due to flux saturation in the core-results in a malfunction of the differential relay and also causes a stress impact to the transformer. These have an adverse effect on the security and stability of the power system. In this paper, a nonsynchronous suppressing method is proposed to suppress the inrush current of three-phase transformers. The overvoltages caused by the inrush current can also be avoided. The proposed method is examined by means of experiments, which show excellent results in suppressing the inrush current. The proposed method can be applied to improve the protective relaying system of three-phase transformers.

articleTitle: A graph object oriented database model in distributed environment
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The graph data model allows us to view a database in a graph G(V,E). For any large semi-structured application under distributed environment, the entire database needs to be fragmented at different sites for better utilization of the existing resource. The graph model also needs the fragmentation in such a way that the fragmented subgraphs can constitute the original graph without any loss. In this paper, the proposed graph data model has been utilized in a distributed environment with suitable examples in the area of a hospital management system.

articleTitle: Priority ordered BP neural network and the application for speaker identification
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The backpropagation neural network (BPNN) has been researched and applied to solve the problem that the training time of the backpropagation network can be excessive, so the structure and training algorithm of priority ordered BP neural networks are proposed. The neurons of its output layer have priority ordered interconnections, during the training course, the training data tails off gradually, so the algorithm may converge rapidly because of the decrease of the complexity of performance function. Compared with the conventional BPNN, the total iterative epochs of priority ordered BPNN are far lower and the performance function can converge more rapidly in a text-independent speaker identification task.

articleTitle: Tsinghua lunar rover prototype and its hardware design
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the hardware architecture of a lunar rover prototype with six wheels driven independently is discussed. Six driving control modules with the same hardware configuration but different software serial numbers are connected via the EIA RS-485 network to control the six wheels respectively. Each driving module is responsible for the control of the steering speed and turning angle of a certain wheel, and can communicate with the host computer in the rover prototype in real time.

articleTitle: Adaptive motion control of a two-link direct drive manipulator using disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The proposed system is realized by appending the disturbance observer to the type-2 servo in order to reduce the tracking error of trajectory control. Furthermore, the adaptive control is applied to control the deterioration of the tracking performance by the variation of payload. It is verified by the practical experiment that the adaptive control is very useful in the case of the nonlinear torque has small effect compared to the friction torque.

articleTitle: An agent architecture with adaptive and learning capability
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The decoder of AHC uses the BOXES algorithm to divide the input state variables into several regions (or boxes). The drawback of this division is that it strongly depends on an engineer's expertise. In addition, the region of each box cannot be modified even when the working environment changes or the resolution is unsatisfactory. To solve this problem, we use the ART theory to improve the decoding mechanism of the AHC architecture to propose and ART-based AHC architecture. We use this architecture to construct three agents. Each agent can control the mobile robot individually, and they perform well in simulations.

articleTitle: Eye extraction using spatial fuzzy clustering method
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Facial features extraction and tracking are crucial steps for many multimedia communication applications such as automated visual interpretation, human face recognition, and development of high quality model-based coding (e.g. MPEG-4) systems. Among different facial features, eyes and lip play an important role in either recognition process or teleconferencing applications. However, automatic human facial features detection is a difficult task due to different scale, rotation and translation of the features. This paper describes a computational approach for locating the eye position from a given eye window. The proposed algorithm extracts the eye in two stages. The iris first is extracted using a region-based energy minimization approach from the membership map generated by the spatial fuzzy clustering technique. In second two, control points are detected to locate the sclera and two parabolas are used to model the upper and lower eyelids. Satisfactory results have been achieved with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research of peer discovery method in peer-to-peer network
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) networking technology is a currently emerging technology in the network research domain. And it is being taken seriously by lots of scientists and researchers. Peer discovery is an important problem in the P2P network communications. In this paper, several popular peer discovery methods are introduced and analyzed. On the basis of this, a peer discovery method using IP multicast and JXTA technology is proposed and the framework is realized through Java programming on the Java/sup TM/ 2 Platform.

articleTitle: Blind adaptive distributed decorrelating detector for DS-CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A blind adaptive distributed decorrelating detector is proposed for DS-CDMA system in both additive white Gaussian noise and fading channels in. this paper. It combines spatial diversity and decorrelating detection. The performance of decorrelating detector do not depend on the other users' energies and the other users' fading characteristics. The blind adaptive diversity-combining scheme based on stochastic gradient techniques is formulated using optimal likelihood ratio testing criterion, and its performance is evaluated in numerical examples, and compared with that of the other combining schemes. The proposed method is suitable for real-time implementation and can provide a significant receiver performance and system capacity gain.

articleTitle: Information geometry on ensemble HME model
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: An extendable framework is developed for an ensemble HME model based on the theoretical analysis of information geometry. In a hierarchical set of systems, a lower order system is included in the parameter space of a large one as a subset. Such a parameter space has rich geometrical structures that are responsible for the dynamic behavior of learning. The HME network divides a task into small tasks by the principle of divide and conquer to improve the performance of a single network. By studying the dual manifold architecture for mixtures of neural networks and analyzing the probability of knowledge-increasable model based on information geometry, the paper proposes a new method to achieve the multi-HME model that has knowledge-increasable and structure-extendible ability. The method helps to provide explanation of the transformation mechanism of the human recognition system and understand the theory of the global architecture of neural network.

articleTitle: DSP-based implementation of matrix converter
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a 2.2 kW 3 /spl phi/ -3 /spl phi/ matrix converter for AC motor application is presented. The control strategy and hardware design are described. In order to achieve the sinusoidal average input currents and output line voltages, the space vector technique is applied in the control strategy. The modulator is implemented with DSP and PLD (programmable logic device). Sinusoidal input and output currents with low harmonics are achieved. Some experimental results are given and the performance of the matrix converter is discussed.

articleTitle: A recursive root moment method for finding roots of polynomials based on neural constrained learning method
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper proposes using the recursive root moment method (RRMM) based on feedforward neural networks (FNN) trained by a constrained learning algorithm (CLA) to find the roots of polynomials, which is of lower computational complexity than the root moment method (RMM) and the method using the relations between the roots and the coefficients (RRC) of polynomials. As a result, the RRMM has faster training speed and higher accuracy than the latter two methods. The experimental results verify our claims.

articleTitle: Analysis of lightning induced electric field and its components on and above the lossy earth's surface by modified dipole technique
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a conceptually simple and computationally efficient technique is used to analyze lightning induced electric field and its components on and above the finitely conductive earth's surface. The present approach overcomes the limitations of Sommerfeld integral and wave-tilt function methods used for investigating the effect of earth's conductivity on the lightning induced electric fields. The key step in the present approach is to determine the image dipole considering the effect of earth's finite conductivity and to use the model for analyzing lightning induced electric field and its components. It has been observed that the horizontal electric field is highly affected by the earth's conductivity; but the vertical electric field is found to be unaffected. Initially the induction component of vertical electric field is negative and changes its polarity from negative to positive, where the induction component of horizontal electric field is found to become zero, with further increase in time.

articleTitle: Flight course replay and simulation base on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Open graphics language (OpenGL) is a kind of accelerating graph software having quick speed and high quality, it has became industry standard of 3D graph software interface. This paper analyzed how to realized creating model, simulation and dynamic drive using OpenGL for research of flight course replay and simulation.

articleTitle: Effect of user mobility on soft handoff performance in cellular communication
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The handoff rate is a fundamental index to evaluate the handoff performance and as a result it affects the overall performance of a cellular mobile communication system. Meanwhile, moving patterns of mobiles are critical to the handoff rate. In this paper the effect of user's mobility on system handoff rate is studied The analytic result shows that the soft handoff rate increases with the mobile speed linearly, which is confirmed by the simulation results. Based on it, the effect of the combinations of users' multiple velocities on the handoff rate is investigated. It turns out that the handoff rate of a system with several user mobility patterns can be estimated with the handoff rates of corresponding single user mobility pattern systems.

articleTitle: Adaptive neural networks-fuzzy reasoning information fusion system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive neural networks-fuzzy reasoning information fusion system which is employed to decrease the influence of the uncertainty of sensor state on fusion performance under a complex environment. The model consists of a confidence estimator, fusing weight knowledge base and weighted fusion. When utilizing the new model, we can obtain the confidence of each sensor and the reliable fusion data with an adaptive synthetical computation of sensor state, sensor detection precision and track filtering error based on the techniques of neural networks, fuzzy reasoning and knowledge base. The simulation results show that the new fusion model is obviously advantageous compared with the conventional Kalman weighted fusion.

articleTitle: Network-based dynamic visual man-on-board order-picking method in AS/RS
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper proposes a new kind of visual method for man-on-board order-picking in automated storage/retrieval system (AS/RS) using network technology and panel pc. By using the storage assignment policies and sequencing algorithms, we can improve the performance of the man-on-board order-picking method, increasing the throughput capacity of AS/RS. After introducing the framework of this new method, we present an analytical model and analyze the system performance for the case of using dynamic job inserting.

articleTitle: Necessary and sufficient condition for the Schur stability of interval polynomial
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, we first establish a sufficient condition for the Schur stability, then use that result to establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the robust Schur stability of interval polynomial, from which an algorithm is developed to determine the Schur stability of interval polynomial. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the applicability of our algorithm.

articleTitle: An evolving intrusion detection system based on natural immune system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, we present a framework of an evolving intrusion detection system (IDS) based on the immune principle. At first we describe the research and trends in intrusion detection systems. Then we introduce the research on immunity-based intrusion detection systems. Next a framework for the intrusion detection system is presented based on the immune principle described above. Finally, the paper is concluded with general comments concerning our framework.

articleTitle: Development of interactive multimedia in teaching engineering materials
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: An effort to incorporate interactive multimedia technology in the teaching of engineering materials at the University Tenaga Nasional, Malaysia has been initiated. The preliminary work involves the construction of a lecture set of interactive multimedia tutorials to facilitate the teaching of an introductory first year course such as engineering materials that is taught in the Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering program. The topics that have been covered in this first prototype system include microstructure development and phase equilibrium diagram. The ultimate goal of the project is to gain the perception of the local students and to understand how best to integrate such technology in the teaching of engineering subjects such as engineering materials.

articleTitle: A novel approach for detecting human face with various poses
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper describes a novel approach to detect the rough face and facial feature regions with various poses in gray intensity images. Using the eye edge information and gray distribution, an energy function is designed to evaluate whether the current rectangle in the image contains the eye region or not. Basing on the extracted eye region, the potential mouth region is evaluated as to whether it contains a mouth by using some rules. A genetic algorithm is used to perform the search process in the whole input image according to the value of an energy function. Experimental results show that the proposed approach is fast and reliable.

articleTitle: Neural network-based adaptive robust control for a class of uncertain systems with measurement noise
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, neural networks (NNs) and adaptive robust control (ARC) design philosophy are integrated to design performance-oriented control laws for a class of uncertain systems whose output is corrupted by external disturbances. The derived adaptive-robust control schemes not only guarantee all the signals are bounded in the closed loop, but also make the system preserve certain prescribed properties. The cone-bounded assumption on the uncertain dynamics is removed via neural networks. The feedback information is the state with measurement noise.

articleTitle: The linearity improvement of LNA for W-CDMA
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: While an LNA (low noise amplifier) has several requirements (high gain, low noise figure, low in out VSWR, and high stability), it is difficult to satisfy the desired specifications all together. Moreover, W-CDMA (wideband code division multiple access) receiving systems require high linearity to have good sensitivity, and the portable communication devices have low power consumption. It is important to select an appropriate transistor and have some trade offs among the required specifications to satisfy and optimize various specifications. We designed and fabricated an LNA which can be used in a W-CDTWA receiving system. For improving the input VSWR and stability an inductance composing of series feedback was added to the emitter, and for acquiring high-linearity at low DC bias current the by-passing method was used. The fabricated LNA had a power gain of 15.33 dB, NF 2.17 dB, S/sub 11/ 9.53 dB, S/sub 22/ 35.91 dB at 2.16 GHz, and IIP/sub 3/ +5.34 dBm with 10 MHz channel spacing. We think that this LNA can be applied to a W-CDMA receiving system.

articleTitle: Topology and control strategy of a novel APF based traction supply system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A novel power supply system for railway traction is present, in which an active power filter is utilized to counteract the quality deteriorating in the three phase power distribution system caused by the single-phase traction system. The proposed system adopts a uniphase topology, which enables all the trains run on the same phase along its whole journey, whereas, at every point where the two system are connected, the single-phase load acts as a symmetrical pure resistance of the three-phase system. Configuration and analysis of the system, a frequency-limited hysteresis current control strategy, and software simulation results that can prove the system's feasibility are included.

articleTitle: Realization of model simulation layered display and control base on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper extends the principle, process and method of layered displays and control based on the OpenGL technology to an application for the flight cockpit's instrument playback system. The author has adopted the C++Builder 4.0 as the program language, using flight parameter data and techniques of quadratic surface, extra clip plane, texture mapping, pattern transform, texture control and depth test, etc. The complex layered display and control of cockpit instrument model can be realized by using the approach.

articleTitle: Color image watermarking based on DCT-domains of color channels
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Digital watermarking has been proposed as a method for discouraging illicit copying and distribution of copyrighted material. Now, there are many watermarking schemes for still color images, we present an approach for embedding digital watermarking information into color channel DCT (discrete cosine transform) domains of the image. We observe that the correlation value between the color channel DCT coefficients is satisfied with some kind of statistical regular, by means of this statistical regular, we can modify the selected sets of DCT coefficients to make the correlation values show specific distribution, so that we can embed a binary string into the image. Specifically, the embedded watermarking is extracted without resorting to the original image and any other data sets. Experimental results demonstrate that the watermark is robust to most of the image and signal processing techniques, and also our schemes are shown to provide very good results both in terms of image transparency and robustness.

articleTitle: A 900 MHz CMOS RF power amplifier with digitally controllable output power
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A 900 MHz CMOS power amplifier with digitally controllable output has been designed using 0.6 /spl mu/m, standard CMOS process. The designed power amplifier has a 4 nH load of integrated spiral inductor and composed of digitally controllable switch-mode pre-amplifiers and class-C output stage. Especially, the Q-enhancement circuit compensates low Q of integrated spiral inductor and is operating as cascade amplifier, also. The output power of the designed amplifier can be controlled from 3 dBm to 135 dBm using the proposed power control method. Under 3 V power supply voltage, the maximum PAE (power added efficiency) is 55% at 900 MHz input frequency.

articleTitle: Sequential diagnostic strategy for the diagnosis of complex systems
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: For the hardness of diagnosing a complex system, the diagnosis often includes many cycles in order to get the enough diagnostic depth, and the sequential diagnostic strategy is used widely to enhance the efficiency of this process. In this paper, an on-line diagnostic algorithm is used in our expert system to make the sequential diagnostic decision, and the multi-signal dependency model is applied to get the relationship of faults and tests The MADM method based on the value function is introduced as the evaluation function in this algorithm for more generalization. Each test is evaluated synthetically with two factors, the information gain and cost. A method is proposed to calculate the attribute weights in MADM according to the practical constrained conditions.

articleTitle: Load/pressure increment predict model analysis
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A boiler dynamic model is a relatively complicated model. In order to construct a more practical control system, we must analyse the more detailed dynamic process. This paper introduces a new analysis method named load/pressure increment prediction model. This increment prediction model can fit the practical signal well. Simulation illustrates the introduced method.

articleTitle: Further improvement of Lagrange multiplier method for optimal bit allocation
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Dynamic programming algorithms based on the Lagrange multiplier method is often used for calculating an optimal bit allocation strategy to minimize the total distortion given a constrained rate budget in both source and channel coding applications. Due to possible large quantizer set and improper initialization, the algorithm often suffers from a large computational complexity. A simple but efficient algorithm is presented to further speed up the convergence of the algorithm. This algorithm can be easily implemented and then results in a very fast solving process. The experimental results show that our new algorithm can catch the optimal solution with a speed 5/spl sim/7 times faster than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Synchronization of the Duffing oscillator by using terminal sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a terminal sliding mode controller used for the chaos synchronization of the Duffing oscillator. The error dynamical equation between the master subsystem and the slave subsystem is established firstly. Then the controller drives the error variables of the error dynamics to zero. The time taken to reach the equilibrium point from any initial states is guaranteed to be in finite time and the chaos synchronization is realized by using the controller. Simulation results are presented to validate the analysis.

articleTitle: A new approach to third-order common-base transistor circuit
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The third-order common-base transistor circuit is a kind of chaotic signal generator, which can be easily realized in any laboratory. The principal purpose of this paper is studying the dynamics and great variety of one-parameter bifurcation phenomena in it. Computer simulation and laboratory experiment are used to analyze its characteristics. Several strange attractors, the intermittent attractor, periodic windows, cascades of period doubling, period plus two and period minus one phenomena are observed by adjusting the value of an inductor. The computer simulation results agree with the experiment results quite nicely.

articleTitle: Researches on signals from PMF for PMD compensation
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a method of splitting signals from fast and slow axes of polarization maintaining fibers by using a polarization splitter. It analyzes the relationship of the electrical power spectrum versus differential group delay and relative angles between the axis of a fiber and the direction of a polarization splitter. Primary experiments are made with the presented scheme, which has the potential of developing as a method of solving the polarization mode dispersion (PMD) problem.

articleTitle: Development of remote control system for boiler based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: We developed the remote boiler control system based on internet to enhance the flexibility with minimum change of the structure of the conventional boiler system. The Hello Device 1300 is applied to the system as a Web server between the Ethernet and the boiler system manufactured by Kiturami Boiler Co., which is accessible from the HD 1300 via the RS0232 serial terminal. The developed control system is operated on a client program based on Java Applet independently from the OS. Some experimental results shows the reliability and flexibility of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Mandarin digit string speech recognition using linear discriminant analysis and tone discrimination model
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Acoustic models based on the conventional hidden Markov model do not have high recognition performance for the connected Mandarin digit string, because highly confusable syllables exist. The state-specific linear discriminant analysis is adopted to reduce the substitution errors of confusable digits. The recognition rate for the isolated digit is increased from 97.16% to 99.32%; and the unknown length digit string from 86.5% to 88.18%. Furthermore experiments show that most of the typical confusions can be discriminated by the pitch contour patterns, the tone discrimination models are trained and the two-pass recognition algorithm to combine the acoustic model likelihood and the tone discrimination model likelihood is developed. By tone discrimination the relative digit string error rate is reduced by 37.4%. The unknown length digit string recognition rate and its digit recognition rate are increased from 88.18% and 97.54% to 92.6% and 98.21%, respectively.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of a fault-tolerant irregular network
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In an attempt to improve the fault-tolerance of the Omega network, this paper examines the performance of the proposed Theta network (THN), and compares it with other networks having similar characteristics. The irregular nature of the network has the inherent advantage of improving the latency of the network. Analytical results exhibit the favorable performance of THN at low cost, making the reliability degrade gracefully with time, while maintaining full-access capability over a reasonably long time. We study methods for routing requests in the presence and absence of faulty components in THN, where 50% of the requests pass at the minimum path length of 2.

articleTitle: Visual quality improvement of image subband coder with dithering
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper investigates effect of dithering in improving the visual quality of an image subband coder. A subband coder with scalar quantization of lowest frequency subband and pyramid vector quantization of high frequency subbands was simulated. For subband quantizer both types of subtractive and non-subtractive dither were examined, and the coder performance was compared with the non-modified coder by subjective and objective tests. In a series of pair comparison subjective tests, coder with subtractive dither gained a total average score of 0.32 (in the scaled range of [-1,1]) and the coder with non-subtractive dither gained an average score of 0.24 compared to non-dithered coder. As an objective measure the correlation between reconstruction error and original image was calculated, which shows that dithering will result an average of 10 percent reduction in case of non-subtractive dither and 12 percent reduction for subtractive dither.

articleTitle: New common mathematical models of fanners performance based on the partial least squares regression method
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, the partial least squares regression (PLS) method is adopted for the first time to solve the multivariate and nonlinear surface fitting problem of fanner regulation performance. With this new method, two new types of optimizing mathematical models (PLS1 and PLS2) are developed, and the detailed steps for doing so are also given. By taking a centrifugal fan and an axial flow fan for example, the paper develops and evaluates the common simulation models of regulation performance with high precision and comprehensive applicability. In addition, the applications of these two types of models are discussed.

articleTitle: Fuzzy hybrid filter for removal of impulse noise from highly corrupted images
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A fuzzy hybrid filter (FHF) is presented which can remove impulse noise from highly corrupted images while preserving details. Primarily, the noise ratio in the filter window is defined and detected. Then we present a new detection algorithm of the corrupted degree of central pixel in the filter window, and fuzzy decision based on fuzzy rules, construct the fuzzy membership function. Finally, a fuzzy hybrid filter (FHF) is designed for the removal of impulse noise from highly corrupted images. Experimental results indicate that our algorithm impressively outperforms other techniques in terms of noise suppression and detail preservation across a wide range of impulse noise corruption, ranging from 5 % to 80 %. Moreover the FHF can effectively restore images corrupted with mixed Gaussian and impulse noise.

articleTitle: Vector quantization neural network for ECG signal compression
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Better compression results can be achieved by coding vectors instead of scalars. The proposed algorithm is used for competitive learning of a vector quantization neural network, which is used to generate a codebook for the vector quantization of ECG signals. The competitive learning algorithm can successfully group the sample group to generate the codebook and reproduce at the time of reconstruction.

articleTitle: Optimized neural net control using genetic algorithm for intermittent system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: A PID-like Neural Net control algorithm is developed, and Genetic Algorithm is integrated into for optimizing the learning rates. The dynamic properties for an intermittent Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC) system are analyzed, and MATLAB/Simulink model for Neural Net control algorithm is introduced. The simulation for large delay systems and the industrial intermittent HVAC system application is reported.

articleTitle: An analysis of phase correlation demodulation used in TCM
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Under the instruction of trellis coded modulation (TCM), a method of combining TCM with phase correlation demodulation is designed. The computer simulation shows that this method has an advantage over classical digital communication.

articleTitle: Research on dispatch network using hybrid strategy WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper introduced the geographic information system (GIS) techniques, especially how to integrate Web and GIS technology to browse and analyze spatial information. First, three kinds of resolving plane for WebGIS in Internet were analyzed, and their advantages and disadvantages discussed. Secondly, a prototype of a GIS application, which was based on the hybrid strategy using Windows DNA architecture, for dispatch of distribution network control was described. The system's design was presented in detail. The testing result was shown and conclusions were based on it.

articleTitle: Some QoS issues in 3G wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The research on QoS of 3G networks is becoming more and more, important. This paper discusses some problems about QoS in 3G networks such as: (a) introduction of the architecture of service differentiation in UMTS. Four QoS classes have been defined. Each class is intended to carry traffic of different kinds of applications. (b) The mapping of UMTS QoS to external IP network is given in order to provide users with end-to-end QoS. (c) As the "last hop" of the IP network, the wireless network has its own unique set of complex characteristics. As the methods of improving the behavior of the wireless link, some methods of optimizing TCP for wireless IP network are presented to meet end-to-end IP performance.

articleTitle: Embedded system engineering in pervasive computing era: a software approach
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Pervasive computing is a new IT application paradigm of which our world will be saturated with tremendous embedded systems involving in our daily life. In this paper roadmap of embedded systems from software viewpoint is presented for innovative pervasive computing. Important technology trends are analyzed and new challenges in such a situation is discussed in detail, furthermore, several promising research areas are introduced.

articleTitle: Recovery of broadband speech from narrowband speech by radial basis function neural networks
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper presents a novel method to recovery of broadband speech from narrowband speech. The approach is based on estimating independently the spectral envelope using a radial basis function (RBF) neural network, a well-known model of artificial neural networks and the excitation function. The simulation results show that the proposed method is effective in the estimation of missing frequency components. Moreover, in listening tests, around 84% of the mean opinion score (MOS) was obtained by implementing the proposed recovery scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal parallel weighted multiselection
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Weighted multiselection requires us to select r elements from a given set of n elements, each associated with a weight such that each element selected is on a pre-specified weighted-rank, where an element is on weighted-rank k if it is the smallest element such that the aggregated weight of all elements not greater than it in the set is not smaller than k. This paper presents efficient algorithms for solving this problem both sequentially and in parallel on EREW PRAM. Our sequential algorithm solves this problem in time O(nlogr) which is optimal. Our parallel algorithm runs in O(T/sub 1/logr) time on an EREW PRAM with 1 < p /spl les/ n processors, and is optimal with respect to T/sub 1/ which is the time complexity for single-element weighted selection using p processors. We give a parallel algorithm for single-element weighted selection using p EREW processors which runs cost-optimally in O(n/p) time for 1 < p /spl les/ nloglogn/logn, and time-optimally in O(logn/loglogn) time for nloglogn/logn < p /spl les/ n.

articleTitle: Basic metrics for performance estimation of computers
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: Performance of computer hardware is often the key to the effectiveness of an entire system of hardware and software. Although the problem of assessing the overall performance of a computing system is still somewhat intractable, much can be gained from efforts at measuring and evaluating various aspects of the internal activities of a computing system. This paper reviews different metrics used to measure performance and analyses the major factors that influence the performance of a computer.

articleTitle: An algorithm for text categorization with SVM
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper summarily introduces some aspects about data mining, text categorization and support vector machines and shows general process of text machine learning. It suggests a method of transforming text categorization problem to a series of binary classification problems and presents an algorithm for text categorization with SVM.

articleTitle: Intelligent diagnosis method for plant machinery using wavelet transform, genetic programming and possibility theory
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent diagnosis method for plant machinery using wavelet transform (WT) genetic programming (GP) and possibility theory. The WT is used to extract feature spectra of each machine state from measured vibration signal for distinguishing faults. Excellent symptom parameters (SP) for detecting fault states are automatically generated by GP. The membership functions of symptom parameters are established using possibility theory for resolving the ambiguous diagnosis problems. The methods proposed in this paper are verified by applying them to the fault diagnosis of gear equipment.

articleTitle: Theoretical investigation on the influence of phase errors in AWG
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The optical path deviation, also quoted as phase error, is a key element determining the crosstalk and insertion loss performance in arrayed waveguide gratings (AWG). This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the character of phase errors in AWG. We have developed a statistical model to estimate the influence of phase errors in silica-based AWG by using Fourier optics and scalar diffraction theory. Also, the filter property of AWG caused by phase errors is analyzed. To maintain the adjacent crosstalk <-25 dB. There is a standard deviation maximum /spl sigma//sub max/ of phase errors to the design of AWG.

articleTitle: Neural network adaptive control and its application to Vibroseis system
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: The paper focuses on a direct adaptive control plant developed for highly uncertain nonlinear systems, that does not rely on state estimation. In particular, we consider single-input/single-output nonlinear system, whose output has known, but otherwise arbitrary relative degree. This includes systems with both parameter uncertainty and unmodeled dynamics. The result is achieved by extending the universal function approximation property of parameterized neural networks to model unknown system dynamics from input/output data. The network weight adaptation rule is derived from Lyapunov function analysis, and guarantees that the adapted weight errors and the tracking error are bounded. Based on the design of adaptive neural network control, a practical application to the Vibroseis system has been achieved.

articleTitle: A novel design for H/sup /spl infin// control via T-S fuzzy model
publicationTitle: 2002 IEEE Region 10 Conference on Computers, Communications, Control and Power Engineering. TENCOM '02. Proceedings.
abstract: In this paper, a novel H/sup /spl infin// control design is proposed on the basis of T-S fuzzy model. The controller is divided into two parts, one is designed based on the idea of parallel distributed compensation (PDC), to guarantee the stability, and the other is an H/sup /spl infin// control to attenuate the external disturbance.
